title: UI text (data/strings.json)
description: Every text the game shows, by key. {name} marks a value filled in by the game, e.g. "v{version}". Room and biome names live in their own files.

strings.description: Key → text. Keys are dotted groups, e.g. "hud.integrity"; a group may hold an id with underscores ("spell.cut_paste"). The listed keys are the ones the game uses; others are allowed while drafting.

game.title.description: Game name in the HUD corner.

game.version.description: Version next to the name; {version} is the game version.

hud.spellSwitch.description: Key hint beside the selected spell, shown once he knows more than one.

spell.zap.description: Name of the Zap spell (the selected-spell tag).

spell.shield.description: Name of the Shield spell (the selected-spell tag).

hud.movementGrid.description: Persistent HUD tag while movement is grid-aligned (default).

hud.movementScreen.description: Persistent HUD tag while movement is screen-relative.

hint.fullscreen.description: Hint shown while the game is drawn below 1080 pixels high.

banner.room.description: Banner on entering a room; {room} is the room name.

banner.biome.description: Line under the room banner; {biome} is the biome name.

banner.spell.description: Banner when a data disk installs a spell; {spell} is its name.

banner.buff.description: Banner when a buff chip is taken (D93); {stat} is the stat's name ("buff.<stat>"), {amount} " +1" or " +10" (empty for recharge).

msg.boot.description: Terminal message when the game starts.

msg.welcome.description: Second terminal message when the game starts.

msg.die.description: Terminal message when the wizard falls into a hole.

msg.void.description: Terminal message when the wizard lands on a void block.

msg.derez.description: Terminal message when the wizard loses his last integrity point.

msg.respawn.description: Terminal message when the wizard recompiles at the room entrance; {backups} is how many backups he has left (D96).

msg.noBackups.description: Terminal message when he dies with no backups left: the system crashes (D96).

msg.crash.description: Terminal message when he reboots on the nearest backup shrine after a crash (D96).

msg.backupSaved.description: Terminal message when he steps onto a backup shrine (D96).

banner.crash.description: Banner title after a system crash (D96).

banner.crashSub.description: Banner line under it; {room} is the room he rebooted in.

msg.plug.description: Terminal message when a pushed object fills a hole.

msg.spellInstalled.description: Terminal message when a data disk installs a spell; {spell} is its name.

msg.buffInstalled.description: Terminal message when a buff chip is taken (D93); {stat} and {amount} as in banner.buff.

msg.refillIntegrity.description: Terminal message when a refill restores integrity.

msg.refillEnergy.description: Terminal message when a refill restores energy.

msg.unlocked.description: Terminal message when every switch in the room is on and its locked exits open.

msg.movementGrid.description: Terminal message when movement switches to grid-aligned.

msg.movementScreen.description: Terminal message when movement switches to screen-relative.
